title: A negative solution to the complemented subspace problem for Banach spaces with unconditional bases
summary: We give a negative solution to the complemented subspace problem for Banach spaces with unconditional bases over both the real and complex fields. For every $ρ>0$, we construct a projection $P_ρ$ of norm less than $1+ρ$ on a separable superreflexive space \begin{equation*} X_ρ=\left(\bigoplus_{j=1}^{\infty}\ell_{p_j}^{N_j}\right)_2, \qquad p_j\downarrow2, \end{equation*} such that $Z_ρ=P_ρ(X_ρ)$ and its dual $Z_ρ^*$ have Schauder bases but admit no unconditional bases.
